blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The low-pressure area (LPA) that Pagasa had been monitoring outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) has developed into a tropical depression and may enter the country’s monitoring zone in the coming days, the state weather bureau said Monday. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said in its 5 p.m. weather forecast that the tropical depression was last located 2,645 kilometers east of Eastern Visayas. It had maximum sustained winds of 55 kilometers per hour (kph) near the center and gustiness of up to 75 kph while moving west-southwestward at 35 kph. READ: LPA forms […]...
